bond_type_encoding: bond_type = raw edge_class + 1 (SINGLE=1, DOUBLE=2, TRIPLE=3, AROMATIC=4, UNK=5); one-based
bond_unknown_policy: map_to_UNK: raw edge_class 4 maps to UNK id 5; raw classes 0..3 map to ids 1..4
description: Explicit Lipophilicity structure schema built from the committed label-free raw graph. Atom/bond/global widths and vocabularies are independent of legacy_zinc.  Disconnected molecules and isolated atoms are supported with finite statistics.
disconnected_policy: supported with finite statistics: unreachable pairs are excluded from diameter/mean distance, reported separately via frac_unreachable_pairs, and never counted as a finite distance >= 3
